Specification: This specification defines a minimal TLA+ module containing a single state variable x and one constant-valued operator foo equal to 1. The comments indicate the file is intended to trigger TLC error behavior related to configuration files and temporal formulas containing actions, but the module itself does not define an initial predicate, next-state relation, or complete temporal specification. It therefore models no full algorithm or protocol, and instead serves as a tiny test artifact illustrating tooling behavior.
